title: How Command & Conquer Died: The Complete Story
creator: nelvox
timestamp_basis: tile 0 is 0s; 3 by 3 tiles per sheet, interval 10000 ms

observations.evidence_type: first-party YouTube preview tile / manual visual inspection
observations.observation: A dark quotation panel covers most of a brown map. The visible sidebar and terrain at the margins carry little information about movement.
observations.fusion_design_question: Keep editorial overlays out of the gameplay readability test.

observations.evidence_type: first-party YouTube preview tile / manual visual inspection
observations.scene: Article card over a top-down view
observations.observation: Dark unexplored areas and a strip of green terrain remain visible around the credit card.
observations.fusion_design_question: Check the returned camera frame and revealed edge of terrain after a briefing.

observations.evidence_type: first-party YouTube preview tile / manual visual inspection
observations.observation: A dark column of commands on the right remains visually separate from the playfield behind a large editorial card.
observations.fusion_design_question: Reserve a stable screen region for world interaction and construction commands on the phone.

observations.evidence_type: first-party YouTube preview tile / manual visual inspection
observations.observation: A pale irregular patch with a pink feature meets black unexplored space. A tall narrow command column and circular emblem occupy the right edge.
observations.fusion_design_question: Test dark unexplored boundaries against pale ground and bright resource colours at game zoom.

observations.evidence_type: first-party YouTube preview tile / manual visual inspection
observations.observation: A first-person weapon silhouette enters from the lower right. A bright green marker sits near the centre against a dark enclosed passage.
observations.fusion_design_question: Give infantry-scale interiors and objective markers their own legibility checks in the Renegade reference profile.

observations.evidence_type: first-party YouTube preview tile / manual visual inspection
observations.observation: Ground texture continues under vehicles and base structures. Hard-edged structures and a curved boundary define a cluster on open terrain. The command UI sits to the right.
observations.fusion_design_question: At standard overhead zoom check whether the base perimeter, available ground and moving unit silhouettes remain separable.

observations.evidence_type: first-party YouTube preview tile / manual visual inspection
observations.observation: A card names Yuriko and contrasts two illustrated panels over a brighter game view.
observations.fusion_design_question: Record Uprising’s character-focused mode as a separate camera and control reference. Verify its asset and input rules from its own sources.

observations.evidence_type: first-party YouTube preview tile / manual visual inspection
observations.observation: The central card explicitly depicts a crawler and describes a mobile base. The surrounding terrain is partly obscured.
observations.fusion_design_question: Test the deployed and moving base as two legible forms. Verify production and population under the C&C4 profile.

observations.evidence_type: first-party YouTube preview tile / manual visual inspection
observations.observation: A horizontal ticked timeline overlays the playfield in a discussion of delayed orders. The scale belongs to the graphic.
observations.fusion_design_question: Measure touch acknowledgement, command application and visual onset separately in Fusion.

observations.evidence_type: first-party YouTube preview tile / manual visual inspection
observations.observation: The card identifies Mental Omega and shows a small overhead image.
observations.fusion_design_question: Track fan work as a distinct influence when a shot comes from a mod.

observations.evidence_type: first-party YouTube preview tile / manual visual inspection
observations.observation: A narrow built crossing spans blue-grey water near a green bank. A wall-like line turns at right angles above it. A right-hand panel contains a small map and controls.
observations.fusion_design_question: Test deck silhouette, traversable bank and ramp entry on a small screen. Use game data to establish bridge behaviour.

observations.evidence_type: first-party YouTube preview tile / manual visual inspection
observations.observation: An article card refers to EA’s 2025 post about the classic games.
observations.fusion_design_question: Use EA’s repository and licence for source attribution.
